basic_info.description: Life in Westwood Park feels like a hidden retreat in the heart of San Francisco; tree-lined streets, historic architecture, and a sense of calm that's hard to find in the city. This fully detached, beautifully renovated 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home blends this rare setting with modern comfort.    Inside, the light-filled living room, with its graceful tray ceiling and wood-burning fireplace, invites cozy gatherings. The formal dining room, framed by original built-ins, flows to a renovated kitchen with quartz counters, stainless appliances, and gas range.    Two spacious bedrooms and a remodeled bath with jetted tub complete the main level. Downstairs, a 2015 permitted renovation added two bedrooms, a spa-inspired bath with dual vanity, laundry, and a family room opening to the elegantly landscaped yard complete with fire pit, string lighting, and seating, perfect for entertaining under the stars.    Refinished hardwood floors, double-pane windows, and preserved period details elevate every space. Minutes from Whole Foods, the public library, Ocean Avenue cafes and shops, and easy freeway access. Epoxy-finished garage with EV charger plus driveway parking. | See more at 14SouthwoodDrive.com
